02 is the area code for Seoul. It is a well-covered metropolitan district which makes guessing quickly in central Seoul advisable here.

South Korea is very urbanised and phone numbers can be found all over the country. However only some of them are helpful in locating where you are. Check the images below to know how to tell apart helpful and unhelpful phone numbers.

031 is the area code for Gyeonggi-Do. The district is well covered compared to others. If it feels more urban then it is advised to guess somewhere near Seoul but there are areas of urban and rural coverage all over the district.

032 is the area code for Incheon. It is a well-covered metropolitan district which makes guessing quickly in central Incheon advisable here. However, if it feels more rural, it could be on the islands either west or north west of the city.

033 is the area code for Gangwon-Do. The district has coverage along most of the east coast and the south western quadrant. It is tough to advise hedging in any particular location here but the non coastal coverage is especially mountainous.

054 is the area code for Gyeongsangbuk-Do. The district has coverage along the entire east coast as well as a lot of coverage more inland, particularly around Daegu. Guessing around Pohang is advised if you see the rearcam car, but other than that it is hard to hedge anywhere but in the middle of the coverage.

055 is the area code for Gyeongsangnam-Do. The district has good coverage in the north-east from Daegu to Ulsan/Busan, and also some coverage on the western border around Hadong which is more rural. If it feels urban then guessing in the eastern coverage is advisable but rural coverage is present in both areas.

061 is the area code for Jeollanam-Do. The district has most of its coverage south and west of Gwangju, extending roughly to Yeongam, Mokpo, and Hampyeong. There is also some coverage in the east around Gwangyang. It is advisable to guess in the western coverage since more coverage is there, but hedging in the middle is also fine.

062 is the area code for Gwangju. The only coverage in this metropolitan district is just south of Highway 25 east of the river. Guessing there quickly is advised.

South Korea is very urbanised and phone numbers can be found all over the country. However only some of them are helpful in locating where you are. Check the images below to know how to tell apart helpful and unhelpful phone numbers.

063 is the area code for Jeollabuk-Do. The district only has coverage around the neighbouring cities of Jeonju and Gimje, and Gochang in the south-west. Jeonju is the main urban city out of the three, which makes guessing quickly in central Jeonju advisable if the coverage is very urban. If not, hedging between the three cities is more advisable.

064 is the area code for Jeju Island. The whole island is well covered so guessing quickly either in the middle or in Jeju City is advised here unless you see coast.
